tagline: Real-time note quantizing with swing and humanize
description: Moves incoming note-ons and note-offs toward a tempo-based grid as they play, with optional swing and random timing and velocity changes. It works without lookahead, so a note can only move within the current audio block, and in practice timing changes are small; velocity humanizing works fully. Built as a MIDI effect, so Ableton Live will not load it; use a host that accepts third-party MIDI effects.

features.name: Grid
features.description: 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32, 1/8 triplet or 1/16 triplet, from the host tempo.

features.name: Strength
features.description: Moves each note from 0 to 100% of the way to the nearest grid line.

features.name: Swing
features.description: Delays every other grid line by up to half a grid step.

features.name: Humanize timing
features.description: Adds a random offset to note-ons of up to 10% of a grid step.

features.name: Humanize velocity
features.description: Adds a random change of up to plus or minus 30 to note-on velocity.
